in_latin.name: Claudellus
in_latin.meaning: Nomen femininum originis Latinae, significans clarus et illustrior
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Claudellus originis Latinae significare potest clarus et illustrior. Claudellum in Latino antiquo usque ad saeculum sextum usum habuit. In medio aevo nomen Claudellus in forma Claudelia usque ad saeculum duodecimum usum habuit. Claudellus significare potest persona clarus et illustrior, vir clarus et virtutibus excellens. In traditione Christiana Claudellus significare potest persona electa a Deo, vir in fide et virtutibus excellens.

in_english.name: Claudelle
in_english.meaning: Feminine given name of Latin origin, meaning clear and illustrious
in_english.long_meaning: The name Claudelle is a feminine given name of Latin origin, meaning clear and illustrious. Claudelle is derived from the Latin name Claudellus, which was used in ancient Rome until the 6th century. In the Middle Ages, the name Claudellus was used in the form Claudelia until the 12th century. Claudelle can signify a clear and illustrious person, a man of great virtue and excellence. In Christian tradition, Claudelle can signify a person chosen by God, a man of great faith and virtues.
